props.gloss_en: she may not go out with a kovelet
R' Meir: and if she went out she is liable to a sin-offering
Chachamim: she may not go out, and if she went out she is exempt
R' Eliezer: a woman may go out with a kovelet ab initio
R' Meir holds it is a burden
the Rabbis hold it is an ornament
the Rabbis: [it is forbidden] lest she take it off and show it, and come to carry it
R' Eliezer: whose way is it to put one on? a woman whose odour is bad; and such a woman does not take it off and show it, and will not come to carry it four amot in the public domain
R' Eliezer exempts with a kovelet and with a flask of palyaton
the stam: [the 'exempt'] is when he stands on R' Meir -- against R' Meir, who said liable to a sin-offering, he said exempt
the stam: [the 'permitted'] is when he stands on the Rabbis -- against the Rabbis, who say exempt but forbidden, he said permitted ab initio
R' Meir: a woman may not go out with a key in her hand, and if she went out she is liable to a sin-offering
the stam: [the baraita] is lacking [words], and this is what it teaches
R' Meir (as reconstructed): and likewise with a kovelet and a flask of palyaton she may not go out, and if she went out she is liable to a sin-offering
R' Eliezer (as reconstructed): exempts with a kovelet and a flask of palyaton
when was this said? when they have perfume in them; but if they have no perfume in them, she is liable
Rav Adda bar Ahava: that is to say, one who carries out less than the measure of food in a vessel is liable
for [a vessel] with no perfume in it is like less than the measure in a vessel
Rav Ashi: here it is different, for there is no substance at all

supports.gloss_en: ומאי רבי מאיר? דתניא: לא תצא אשה במפתח שבידה, ואם יצאת חייבת חטאת, דברי רבי מאיר; רבי אליעזר פוטר בכובלת ובצלוחית של פלייטון (kind tanya_kevatei: no kind names a bare דתניא)
זאת אומרת ... דהא אין בה בושם כפחות מכשיעור בכלי דמי, וקתני חייבת -- the baraita makes her liable for an empty perfume vessel, which is like less than a measure of food in a vessel

deflected_by.gloss_en: בעלמא אימא לך פטור, ושאני הכא דליתיה לממשא כלל -- in general I can say he is exempt; the empty vessel differs, for there is no substance in it at all (= p_shani_hacha_leita_lemamasha)

objections.gloss_en: והתניא: רבי אליעזר פוטר בכובלת ובצלוחית של פלייטון! -- elsewhere R' Eliezer only exempts, not permits

answered_by.gloss_en: לא קשיא: הא כי קאי אדרבי מאיר, הא כי קאי אדרבנן -- 'exempt' answers R' Meir's 'liable', 'permitted' answers the Rabbis' 'exempt but forbidden' (= p_kai_adrabbi_meir, p_kai_aderabanan)

objections.gloss_en: כובלת מאן דכר שמה? -- R' Meir spoke of a key; who mentioned a kovelet, that R' Eliezer should exempt it?
